items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible work preserving consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Recommendation: retain SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, reject all new implementation dispatch, and continue existing evidence work. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Revenue is limited to $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and is not site-attributable. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Retain site-specific remediation and evidence gates. complicated.work is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks; retain parked status until remediated. deadlymaracas.com is unreachable by DNS with unknown compliance status; retain parked status and require a concrete reachability and compliance checklist before any launch decision. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth.
